what: A1-49000 EMA encoder weights: mean over rows of max|w| / rms(w) per output row (crest/row), the same per 128-column group (crest/g128), and per-row kurtosis E[(w-mean)^4]/var^2 (3 for a Gaussian); averaged over the layers of each kind
why: a per-row symmetric int4 step is max|w|/7, so per-weight quantisation noise relative to the row rms scales with the crest factor (rel. noise ~ crest / (7*sqrt(12)))
